title: tooling(dispatch-gates): STALE TREE counts the sdui-manifest hash sentinels as derivation inputs, so a pm-only tree reads stale on every ui landing
body:
Filed by the `domain:skills#2` seat (`session_01LqKsGyMNFwwnbF5FTAqyPn`, seat post #19287) from the os-dev-report on #26155 (comment 6427482728, `out_of_scope_findings`, class c, named producer) and verified by the independent contract review on PR #26327 (comment 6427853793, ③ Boundary flags). Noticed, not touched, by #26327; ⛔ not a claim.

**Origin:** `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs`, `DERIVATION_SURFACE = ['.github/workflows', '.github/actions', 'package.json', 'scripts']` — the whole `scripts/` tree. `scripts/sdui-manifest.sources/core.json` and `react.json` are hash sentinels regenerated on every `ui/packages/core` or `ui/packages/react` landing, so the STALE TREE reading at `--ran` time names them as "files it derives from" although no derived gate family reads them.
**Reader who acts:** the lane that owns `scripts/pm/**` (tooling).
**Suggested grade (triage grades):** p3 — a false STALE TREE warning on pm-only diffs; it changes no verdict (the derived set was 52 both before and after the warning on #26327) but tells every pm dev to re-base for nothing.

**Who pays:** a dev on a `.claude/**` or `scripts/pm/**` card whose `--ran` reconciliation prints STALE TREE whenever a ui PR landed meanwhile, and the seat reading the report who must then decide whether the warning is real.

**Measured (#26327, head `b04d9371`):** the derivation before the runs reported STALE TREE 7 commits behind; after a fast-forward to `f00cbe36` the `--ran` reconciliation reported it again, 5 commits behind, naming the two sdui-manifest sentinels — touched by no changed path; the derived command set was 52 both times.

**Wanted:** the STALE TREE reading excludes paths that no derived family reads (at least `scripts/sdui-manifest.sources/**`), or narrows `DERIVATION_SURFACE` to the directories the derivation actually imports (`scripts/pm/**`, the gate scripts named by the root `package.json`), with a self-test case: a tree whose only drift is a sentinel regeneration reads FRESH; a tree whose drift touches `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` or `.github/workflows/**` still reads STALE.

**Card-specific acceptance:** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --ran` on a pm-only branch behind `main` by ui-only landings prints no STALE TREE; `pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates` green with the new case. `Clause-②: no` · `Metadata-protocol: none`.

**Dedupe:** REST listing of every issue updated since 2026-10-01 (505 issues, open + closed), title and body grep for `STALE TREE`, `sdui-manifest.sources`, `DERIVATION_SURFACE` → #26120 (closed: one manifest record per ui registry package) and #26137 (open: CI regenerates the sdui manifest and compares it) are the sentinels' own cards, neither about the dispatch-gates reading; no open card asks for this.
